full_page.content:
1935, January
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 300 Cont.
Jan. 31 Robert Doremus - 6 - five operations for mastoids - bright child but almost deaf.
Martha E. Merritt - 44 - hopeless pneumonia reported on Tuesday last when enrolled. Her nearest relative had been away 12 yrs from Conf. & Church. He promised to go to Confession again etc if wife were spared. To-night she is out of danger and he comes for Confession for To-morrow Ist Friday.
Alice Nacy (St. Mary's Hosp.) 27 - since last April.
Page 301 Page 302
Blank Page
1935, February
Feb. Edwin Benson - 10 - cannot talk otherwise bright .. .
Paul Nestor - 37 - dope .... still tries Jennie Nestor, Mother - in
Mr. & Mrs. Garbnsc of Battle Creek - he Cath. - she method. one boy 14 - he not doing ....
Sister Edward Marie - Monroe
Wm. Haskins - 17 - infantile paralysis quite improved since enroll- ment last Oct. but still far from well - Right side still in bad condition.
6 Phylis Wiggert - non Cath. - 13 - hurt by fall - back still weak- hip joint slips ...
7 Mrs. M. Giff - 27 - suffering from eczema for ten years - said to be incurable and at times terrific. A friend insisted on her prom- ising to come to Monastery and enroll in Ser. Mass Ass'n - That was last Saturday ... Sunday was able to take bandage off hand. Improve- ment has been remarkable every day. Enrolled To-day - 50c. . Has Con- vert husband and one boy - former away 5 yrs. out of ten. Now wants to do right again.
Page 303 Blank Page
Page 304 Feb. Mrs. Brennan - 50 - Avoca, Mich. 3 or 4 minor strokes, - now has quite a bad one - heavy person. ..
